pooling: Mean nodes per chunk, mean chunks per document, mean documents per source; masked attention over available sources conditioned on EPSS hidden state; concatenate temporal state, fused text and source masks.
initialization: Identical complete initial state per seed across all three modes; inactive graph modules are not executed and receive no gradients in EPSS-only.
selection: Earliest strictly best validation MAE from epoch 1; epoch zero excluded; all seeds reported.
limitations: Current descriptions and summaries are retrospective, not authenticated Day-60 content.
Stored SMP date screening alone does not establish historical publication or content availability.
CVE IDs are disjoint; vulnerability families and all shared evidence are not proven disjoint.
TPG validity and version-edge coverage do not establish semantic correctness or forecasting benefit.
Long documents are retained without truncation; independent chunks omit cross-chunk relations.
Validation has informed earlier development; only the reserved test set can provide later final evaluation.
This expanded cohort requires fresh matched controls; earlier H02/R07 scores are not directly comparable.
Smoke metrics check integration only; they do not select configurations or seeds.
